title: Rabindranath Tagore
summary: Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941) was a Bengali poet, writer, composer and painter, and in 1913 became the first non-European Nobel laureate in Literature for Gitanjali. He wrote the national anthems of India and Bangladesh and founded Visva-Bharati in Santiniketan.
